tasks.title: Approve the engagement and owner Part A
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Before you arrive; 24.12d Part A and Risks acknowledged. Confirm current product, channel and hosting choices for this engagement; the copied procedures preserve historical names and do not authorize setup.

definition_of_done.description: Retain owner-signed Part A identifying the company, owner, installer, dates, included and excluded work, employee count, channels, support window and named internal admin.

Record the restricted-document types and access list, at least two owner-appointed vault key holders, hosting location, data-processing agreement, retention and exit terms; the installer retains no vault key.

Retain owner decisions on chat access, employee changes and current channel/stack choices, with initialed risks and mitigations. Review the companion hosting, file-plane and channel-topology procedures and record the versions selected for the engagement.

tasks.title: Prepare the approved deployment
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Before you arrive. Begin after owner Part A has accepted the scope. Preserve the isolated company boundary and the reviewed hosting decisions.

definition_of_done.description: Record the staff/device roster, departments, account needs, machine roles and device identifiers. Retain evidence that the Windows installer is signed and passes on a clean machine.
Demonstrate the approved isolated company cloud stack and its own gateway/bot/profile setup, and retain the reviewed cloud-to-office network ACLs.
Prepare the company Johnny.Decimal draft, wiki host and quiet/headless file-drop configuration, with the approved owner scope and restricted list available to the installer.

tasks.title: Confirm roles, document tiers and the office plan
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Day 1 AM: discovery. Validate the office and staff needs against the approved scope before building the office zone.

definition_of_done.description: Record two or three agreed assistant use cases for each job role and the network/machine audit, including OS versions, admin rights and anchor disk capacity.
Inventory documents into open, internal and restricted tiers; retain owner-reviewed version 1 of the company Johnny.Decimal index.
Record departments, anchors, the librarian anchor and vault locations; review the department/anchor folder matrix and device modes with the owner.

tasks.title: Build and test the office zone
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Day 1 PM: office zone. Use only the approved cloud, network and folder plan; restricted content stays in the vault.

definition_of_done.description: Demonstrate the file drop, librarian and encrypted vault, including write-only upload tests; record every sync device and verify the installed configurations against the owner-reviewed folder matrix.
Retain evidence of running cross-zone backups and one successful restore, identifying the restored file and test date.
For two pilot employees, retain a message and document round-trip showing approved channels and uploads reach the hub, route to the correct assistant and file into the correct tier.

tasks.title: Enroll every employee and verify access boundaries
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Day 2 AM: enrollment; 24.12d Part B employee, upload and folder checks. Keep a per-employee and per-device test log.

definition_of_done.description: For every employee, record installer/profile setup, hub account and primary-channel enrollment, successful message round-trip and document upload through the hub to the correct tier; verify each optional extra channel in use.
Demonstrate that a restricted document sent through chat is refused and redirected to the approved restricted upload link; verify per-profile allowlists and catch-all routing.

Verify each non-anchor receives only company-wide and assigned department open/internal folders, with desktop send/receive and laptop receive-only modes. Verify anchors retain every department replica, restricted folders stay inside the vault, and intake is limited to the librarian anchor and edge.

tasks.title: Train staff and deliver their reference cards
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Day 2 PM: training + handoff; 24.12d Part B. Use the reviewed companion training procedure and quick cards.

definition_of_done.description: Record the 30-45 minute staff training session, attendance and delivery of the appropriate channel quick cards.
Demonstrate the upload/refusal path and fallback/escalation instructions, including checking assistant output before customer-facing or money-related use.

tasks.title: Witness admin add, revoke and support procedures
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Day 2 PM: training + handoff; 24.12d Part B. Retain witnessed evidence of the actual client-side steps and standard support round trip.

definition_of_done.description: Deliver the reviewed runbook to the named internal admin. Witness one employee add, including client-side steps and support-generated configurations/cloud changes.
Witness one profile/device revoke: verify peer-side sync cutoff before tailnet removal, then demonstrate sync fails over both LAN and tailnet.
Confirm the agreed support contact/window, owner-appointed vault key holders and their recorded key storage; schedule the two-week check-in.

tasks.title: Obtain witnessed owner Part B acceptance
tasks.description: Source: 24.12 Risks and Done when; 24.12d Part B: handoff acceptance. Handoff is complete only after the owner and installer review the evidence and sign.

definition_of_done.description: Present every Part B check with witnessed results or evidence: all employee and extra-channel round-trips, uploads, restricted refusal, successful restore, admin add/revoke, training, runbook, keys and folder matrix.
Retain owner and installer signatures and dates on completed Part B, with the scope and risk acknowledgements reconciled against Part A.
Record each carried open item with its owner and due date, the support-window end and the scheduled two-week check-in; have the owner accept this handoff record.
